reason.stillWorks: You can add clients and book sessions; invoicing turns on once billing is connected.

reason.stillWorks: Client records work now; intake forms turn on shortly.

rows.title: Send email to clients
rows.whatIsBlocked: Send email to clients isn't ready yet.
rows.whatStillWorks: Email is working now, sending from our domain until yours is verified.
rows.whatToDo: Add the DNS records shown here to your domain, then we'll verify automatically.

rows.title: Add the services you offer
rows.whatIsBlocked: You have no services yet, so there is nothing to book or invoice for.
rows.whatStillWorks: You can add people and take notes in the meantime.
rows.whatToDo: Add at least one service — a session type, a package, or a plan.

rows.title: Price your services
rows.whatIsBlocked: Your services have no active price, so an invoice cannot be raised from them.
rows.whatStillWorks: Bookings still work; you just cannot bill for them yet.
rows.whatToDo: Set a price on each service. A price change is always a NEW price row, never an edit.

rows.title: Add your first client
rows.whatIsBlocked: Nobody is on your books yet.
rows.whatStillWorks: Everything else is ready for them when they arrive.
rows.whatToDo: Add a person, or send an invite from People.

rows.title: Set when your coaches are free
rows.whatIsBlocked: No coach has any hours, so a client cannot book online.
rows.whatStillWorks: You can still book a session yourself from the calendar.
rows.whatToDo: Add a weekly availability rule for at least one coach.

rows.title: Create a document template
rows.whatIsBlocked: You have no templates, so nothing can be sent for signature.
rows.whatStillWorks: Everything else works; there is simply nothing to send yet.
rows.whatToDo: Create a contract or form template.

rows.title: Connect an account's properties
rows.whatIsBlocked: No account has a connected property, so there is no search, ads or analytics data.
rows.whatStillWorks: Accounts, sites and reporting still work without them.
rows.whatToDo: Connect Search Console, Google Ads, Analytics or a Business Profile on an account.

rows.title: Add your first account
rows.whatIsBlocked: You have no accounts, so there is no site, service or reporting to deliver against.
rows.whatStillWorks: Coaching, documents and money all work without one.
rows.whatToDo: Add a business you deliver work for.

rows.title: Create a recurring plan
rows.whatIsBlocked: You have no plans, so nobody can be put on a recurring subscription.
rows.whatStillWorks: One-off invoices and packages work without one.
rows.whatToDo: Create a plan — a price on a repeating interval.

rows.title: Build your first list
rows.whatIsBlocked: You have no lists, so there is nobody for a campaign to go to.
rows.whatStillWorks: Everything else works; you simply cannot send a campaign yet.
rows.whatToDo: Save a list from the people you already have.

rows.title: Connect Stripe
rows.whatIsBlocked: Stripe Connect is not set up, so you cannot process payments.
rows.whatStillWorks: You can still create documents, schedule sessions, and manage your practice structure.
rows.whatToDo: Connect your Stripe account in Money settings.
